summary: Forum is preparing to move from CLC’s Entrata environment into a Forum-controlled instance. The first-property configuration should prioritize role-based access, Forum ownership of configuration and data, continued Elise AI connectivity during transition, a custom student application journey, and careful testing of effective-rent advertising so concessions do not reduce lawful rent on Ontario lease documents. Several operational choices remain open and should stay at catalog defaults until confirmed.

settings.path: Setup >> Users & Groups >> Users >> Add New User
settings.proposed: Create at least one Forum Operations Admin and one Forum Accounting Admin, with named backups if possible.
settings.confirmText: Likely at least one Operations Admin and one Accounting Admin — confirm with client: Which named Forum employees will own operational and accounting administration at go-live?
settings.meaning: Forum needs its own administrators instead of relying on CLC to change corporate settings, permissions, workflows, and reporting access.
settings.assumption: The implementation project’s operational and accounting leads will become the initial administrators, but the calls did not name the final users.

options.value: At least one Operations and Accounting Admin User
options.effect: Gives Forum accountable owners for operational and financial configuration.

reasoning: Forum repeatedly said the purpose of its own instance is to control configuration, access, reporting, and data inputs.
The implementation plan explicitly requires Forum operational and accounting decision-makers.
The individual administrators were not finalized, so the recommended structure still needs names.

settings.meaning: The website and application should reconcile advertised effective rent with headline rent and the concession, while the Ontario lease continues to show full lawful base rent and the concession remains in a separate addendum.

ruledOut.setting: All Recurring Charges in advertised rent

ruledOut.why: Forum wants a controlled effective-rent calculation. Including every recurring charge could blend furniture, utilities, or other charges into the marketed rent and does not match the stated requirement.

ruledOut.path: Setup >> Properties >> Property >> Commercial Buildings & Suites >> Buildings & Floors
ruledOut.why: The portfolio discussion covers student housing, conventional multifamily, and a single-room-occupancy property, not commercial suite leasing.

callsUsed.title: Forum | Entrata Implementation and Pricing Review
callsUsed.brief: Wheeler and Callin from Entrata, along with Ryan from Forum Asset Management, discussed the implementation of Entrata's software, focusing on a rapid "Entrata to Entrata" migration for student properties by year-end, with conventional properties following in January, to leverage waived implementation fees and avoid disruption to Forum Asset Management's critical leasing cycle.
